text: Authorisation stays with the owning service: the library validates the action, asks the access owner and fails closed, and the object-level decision is the service's own.
why: Architecture v5 slide 10 gives each service the object-level decision from cached rwb-access data and names OWASP API1 object-level authorisation; a shared library that decided the object itself would move the decision away from the service that holds the record and would break the per-service rule of slide 35.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 10 (each service authorises the object itself, OWASP API1, 2 s timeouts, breaker per downstream) and slide 35 (role, scope and DoA checked on every action from rwb-access data); slide 29 (deny by default)
confirm: Security architecture review at the contract freeze
impact: Fixes that the library asks and refuses and never decides the object; no business value changes

text: The permission and masking policy is cached per service, with the time to live read through the parameters client and refreshed on the two access events, so that no service reads a P4 table.
why: Slide 20 requires the two access events for cache refresh and slide 10 requires cached permission data from rwb-access; no source fixes the interval or the parameter key, and a per-service cache is the only shape that satisfies both without a cross-schema read under DP-01.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 10 (cached permission data from rwb-access) and slide 20 (AccessPolicyChanged, DoaLimitChanged to cache refresh); Template and Rules section R5.5 DP-01 and DP-06 (parameters contract and client library)
confirm: Platform review and the parameters catalog owner at the wave 0 gate
impact: Names the cache, its interval and its key only; the guard and masking outcomes of section 7 do not change

text: The masker fills from the value the data owner supplies and never from a token; with no rule the field is masked; id_no_last4 is the clearest identity value the library may hold.
why: ADR-010 and D-RCV-35 U1 remove tokenization and keep the clear identity number inside ACE, and the legacy story states the same rule for the view columns, so the library has no token path and no clear-identity path at all.
read: Legacy RWB-E1-037 sections 4, 8 (BR6, BR10) and 17; ADR-010; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 35 (personal data masked before it leaves, no personal data in events or payloads)
confirm: Compliance and the data owner at the masking review (DL26)
impact: Fixes the source of every filled value; no masking value is chosen by this story

text: The authorise, permission and masking-policy operations are reached at /api/recovery/access/v1/... under the Template and Rules section R4 base, because Architecture v5 slide 14 names the operations and the Ownership Map has no path row for them.
why: Every consumed call needs a base; section R4 gives each service /api/recovery/<short>/v1 and the owner is P4 rwb-access; with no base the contract would have no reachable path, and the old monolith base is prohibited by DP-13.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 14 (POST /authorise, GET /me/permissions, GET /doa-limits, /masking-policies); Template and Rules section R4 (REST base /api/recovery/<short>/v1; DP-13); Ownership Map v1 api rows (no entry for the three operations)
confirm: API review at the contract freeze
impact: Fixes the three consumed paths only; no new path and no new service short is invented

text: The guard and masker are published as one versioned library artefact with major version 1, its contract shapes and its fakes, pinned by the service template.
why: The contract has to be frozen before nineteen services build against it, the template pins one version of the shared libraries, and a major version with published fakes is the only way a service can build and test before the access owner exists.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 20 and 38 (every service from the service template and the shared libraries); RWB-PLT-NF02-APP (one baseline version pinned, drift fails the build); Template and Rules section R5.7 rule 1
confirm: Platform library team and the service template owner at the wave 0 design gate
impact: Names the version and the pin only; the interface content of section 12 does not change
